rules_primary: If the close price of the 1-minute candlestick for copper using the CCU6 contract on August 18, 2026 at 5:00 PM EDT is above 7.38 USD/Lbs, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
Settlement is based on the nearest listed contract month, rolling forward to the next contract 10 business days before the current contract's last trading day.
